title: Admission temperature in preterm and term infants: a retrospective analysis of quality assurance data to identify risk factors for hypothermia
summary: Using quality assurance questionnaires, the body temperature measured in premature and newborn babies on the first day of life is evaluated in order to determine the incidence of hypothermia. In addition, possible risk factors for hypothermia are to be determined and possible measures for prevention derived from this.

interventions.name:
Premature and full-term babies on the first day of life
Data on neonates from the QA forms and data from routine patient records are collected with regard to the perinatal situation and the postnatal clinical course.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Measured temperature on day one
Exclusion criteria:
No temperature an day one
